import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static boolean read(Scanner sc) {
        if (sc.hasNextLong() && sc.hasNextInt()) {
            n = sc.nextLong();
            k = sc.nextInt();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((long)a * b % MOD);
    }

    static class Mat extends ArrayList<long[]> {
        Mat() {
            super();
        }
        static Mat identity(int size) {
            Mat res = new Mat();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                long[] row = new long[size];
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    row[j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
                res.add(row);
            }
            return res;
        }
        static Mat multiply(Mat a, Mat b, int size) {
            Mat c = new Mat();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                c.add(new long[size]);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                long[] rowA = a.get(i);
                long[] rowC = c.get(i);
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int t = 0; t < size; t++) {
                        sum += rowA[t] * b.get(t)[j];
                    }
                    rowC[j] = sum % MOD;
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
        static Mat pow(Mat base, long exp, int size) {
            Mat result = identity(size);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = multiply(result, base, size);
                }
                base = multiply(base, base, size);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Mat[][] amat = new Mat[62][N];

    public static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        List<Long> num = new ArrayList<>();
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            num.add(tempN % k);
            tempN /= k;
        }
        int sz = num.size();

        for (int d = 0; d < k; d++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    amat[0][d] = new Mat();
                    while (amat[0][d].size() <= k) {
                        amat[0][d].add(new long[k + 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(amat[0][d].get(i), 0);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                amat[0][d].get(i)[i] = 1;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                amat[0][d].get(i)[d] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int r = 1; r < sz; r++) {
            List<Mat> pr = new ArrayList<>();
            pr.add(Mat.identity(k + 1));
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    // Already initialized
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                pr.add(Mat.multiply(pr.get(pr.size() - 1), amat[r - 1][i], k + 1));
            }
            for (int sh = 0; sh < k; sh++) {
                amat[r][sh] = new Mat();
                for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                    amat[r][sh].add(new long[k + 1]);
                }
                for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                    Arrays.fill(amat[r][sh].get(i), 0);
                }
                // Initialize as identity
                for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                    amat[r][sh].get(i)[i] = 1;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < k - sh; i++) {
                    Mat tempMat = Mat.multiply(amat[r][sh], amat[r - 1][(i + sh) % k], k + 1);
                    amat[r][sh] = Mat.multiply(amat[r][sh], tempMat, k + 1);
                }
                Mat prSh = pr.get(0);
                for (int i = 0; i < sh; i++) {
                    prSh = Mat.multiply(prSh, amat[r - 1][(i + sh) % k], k + 1);
                }
                amat[r][sh] = Mat.multiply(amat[r][sh], prSh, k + 1);
            }
        }

        long[][] dp = new long[k + 1][k + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
        }
        dp[0][k] = 1;

        int rem = 0;
        for (int i = sz - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            long[] numI = new long[]{num.get(i)};
            while (numI[0] > 0) {
                long[][] newDp = new long[k + 1][k + 1];
                for (int a = 0; a <= k; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= k; b++) {
                        newDp[a][b] = 0;
                    }
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= k; a++) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= k; b++) {
                        if (dp[a][b] != 0) {
                            for (int c = 0; c <= k; c++) {
                                long val = (dp[a][b] * amat[i][rem].get(a)[c]) % MOD;
                                newDp[c][(b + 1) % k] = (newDp[c][(b + 1) % k] + val) % MOD;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                dp = newDp;
                numI[0]--;
                rem = (rem + 1) % k;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[0][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (true) {
            if (!read(sc)) break;
            solve(sc);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
